why: Talking to a voice assistant over a loud beat is the moment Keys fails today, and every voice product producers already use (phones, Sonos, car assistants, DJ mixer talkover) ducks the music on the wake word. The design matches those norms (about -15 dB, fast dip, slow return, hold through the reply) and wisely never ducks during a take. Studio-focused AI tools (Suno Studio Chat, FL Gopher) are typed, so this is a real edge for a voice-first studio.
